name: rnr-plataforma
description: Plataforma de pedidos de Rock N Rolla Cakes: chats de WhatsApp, pedido con IA, nota en PDF y Google Calendar

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/shared && npm run test -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
